notes: Corrected the placement of *of* in `πλήρης ἔργων ἀγαθῶν` → *full of good works*: the case preposition of an anarthrous genitive rides with the governed noun under rules 17, 21 and 69, not with the adjective governing it. Rule 17 states in terms that a source noun rendered by *of + noun* is headed on the noun, which presupposes the unit contains the *of*.
Everything else in the verse holds: αὕτη → *this woman* headed on the demonstrative (rule 17), and διερμηνευομένη → *by interpretation* headed on the noun.
